newsitem.title: UK: EBRD invests in Albania venture capital fund.
newsitem.headline: EBRD invests in Albania venture capital fund.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is investing 2.8 million Ecu in the Euromerchant Albania Fund Limited, Albania's first venture capital fund.

The Euromerchant fund will invest in unlisted private sector small and medium-sized enterprises, promote financial intermediation and provide Albanian companies with services and improvements in corporate governance.
The fund is a limited liability company ioncorporated in Guernsey. It will have a minimum size of eight million Ecu.

Global Finance, a Greek venture capital and private equity management company, will act as fund manager, while the International Finance Corporation, The Albanian Insurance Institute and the Euromerchant bank, the Athens-based bank of the Latsis group will also be shareholders in the Fund.
